body: Observed 2026-10-11 by the V1-0040 slice-1 lane (branch claude/v1-0040-impl). Adding the `corvint test` verb to root help needed three existing phrases shortened to fit the 4096-byte root-help bound (CCF-V1-009). It now has 0 bytes to spare (build log docs/build-log/2026-10-11-session-test-runner-slice-1.md). Expected: adding one verb line does not force rewording unrelated verbs. Actual: the next verb added to root help must trim other text, or the bound must change. Options: group verbs under a shorter summary with `corvint help <verb>` for detail; or a reviewed CCF-V1-009 amendment raising or restructuring the bound.
